raw_segments.text: So escaped we death that lurks beneath the sea, but under day's white light, mistrustful
all of fortune's smile, we sat and brooded deep, shepherds for lorn of thoughts that
wandered wild, o'er this new woe, for Smitten was our host and lost as ashes scattered from
the pyre, of whom if any draw his life breath yet be well assured he deems of us as dead,
as we of him no other fate forebode, but heaven save all.
If Menelaus live, he will not tarry, but will surely come. Therefore, if anywhere the high
sun's ray descries him upon earth, preserved by Zeus, who wills not yet to wipe his race away,
hope still there is that homeward he may wend. Enough, thou hast the truth unto the end.
